runs.text: The ceasefire nobody mentions, in ten words. A friend texts: it didn't start on October seven. On October six, there was a ceasefire. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> broke it. The truce began on May twenty one, two thousand and twenty one, after eleven days of fighting, brokered by Egypt. By September twenty twenty three, Israel had given about eighteen thousand five hundred Gazans permits to work in Israel. Then, on October seven, <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> killed about one thousand two hundred people in Israel. Save this. There was a ceasefire. <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> broke it. Which sentence do you need most? Tell me in the comments. So, what happened on October six?
